mentions.name: 4keynumbers
mentions.description: A super-simple budgeting app based on Ramit Sethi's Conscious Spending Plan that syncs expenses from Plaid and condenses them into a single chart with only four categories: savings, investments, bills/fixed, and "safe to spend".
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a super-simple budgeting app called https://4keynumbers.com, which is based on Ramit Sethi's Conscious Spending Plan. It currently syncs my expenses from Plaid and cooks it down into a single chart, with only savings, investments, bills/fixed, and "safe to spend" as categories.
